name: green rice
instructions:
ARROZ VERDE — Diana Kennedy, The Essential Cuisines of Mexico (Señora María Luisa Camarena de Rodríguez, PUEBLA). Transcribed verbatim 2026-11-21. SERVES 6. UNATTEMPTED.

INGREDIENTS:
- 1 1/2 cups (375 ml) long-grain unconverted white rice
- 1/3 cup (85 ml) vegetable oil
- 1/2 cup (125 ml) cold water, more if necessary
- 1 small bunch flat-leaf parsley
- 3 sprigs cilantro
- 3 large romaine lettuce leaves
- 2 poblano chiles, seeds and veins removed, roughly chopped (NOT CHARRED)
- 2 tablespoons roughly chopped white onion
- 1 garlic clove, roughly chopped
- 2 1/2 to 3 cups (625 to 750 ml) light chicken broth
- salt to taste

PROCEDURE:
1. THE PAN: have ready a heavy-bottomed pan about 4 inches (10 cm) deep and 9 inches (23 cm) across.
2. SOAK + RINSE: cover the rice with hot water and let soak for about 5 minutes. Drain in a strainer, then rinse well in cold water and leave to drain for a few minutes.
3. FRY THE RICE: heat the oil in the pan. Give a final shake to the rice in the strainer and stir it into the oil. Fry over a VERY HIGH heat, turning the rice thoroughly from time to time, until it is a PALE GOLDEN color. Tip the pan to one side, holding back the rice with a wide metal spatula, and drain off about 3 tablespoons of the oil.
4. THE GREEN PUREE: pour the 1/2 cup (125 ml) of water into a blender jar. Add the GREENS, CHILES, ONION, and GARLIC and blend until smooth, adding more water ONLY if absolutely necessary to release the blades of the blender.
5. FRY THE PUREE IN: add the blended ingredients to the rice and fry over high heat, stirring constantly and scraping the bottom of the pan, until the rice is ALMOST DRY. Add the broth and salt to taste and cook over medium heat until all the liquid has been absorbed and small AIR HOLES appear in the surface of the rice — about 15 minutes.
6. Cover the pan with a lid or foil and cook for 5 MINUTES LONGER. Remove from the heat.
7. THE STEAM REST: cover the rice with a piece of TERRY CLOTH and set aside to continue cooking in its own steam for 20 TO 30 MINUTES.
notes:
=== SOURCE ===

Diana Kennedy, The Essential Cuisines of Mexico — her Arroz Verde, credited to Señora María Luisa Camarena de Rodríguez (Puebla). Transcribed verbatim 2026-11-21; UNATTEMPTED.

=== THE METHOD MARKERS — THE KENNEDY RICE CHASSIS ===

Same chassis as [[mexican-rice]] (her Arroz a la Mexicana): hot-water soak + cold rinse, fry the rice in oil over very high heat, drain excess oil, fry a blended puree into the rice until almost dry, broth with no stirring, terry-cloth steam rest. The differences here:

- The puree is GREEN: parsley + cilantro + ROMAINE LETTUCE LEAVES + raw (not charred) POBLANOS + onion + garlic, blended with cold water.
- Fry to PALE GOLDEN (not just turning color), and drain off about 3 tablespoons of oil with a spatula hold-back.
- LIGHT chicken broth, 2 1/2 to 3 cups.
- An extra 5 covered minutes on the heat before the steam rest (20-30 min here).

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[mexican-rice]]: her Arroz a la Mexicana — the tomato sibling, same chassis.
- [[turmeric-rice]] / [[instapot-rice]]: the other rice bases.
